name: Locomotive
definition: rail vehicle that provides the power to haul a train.
notes: Siemens Vectron locomotive page; Vectron X AC/DC/MS and Dual Mode.

name: Railway carriage or wagon
definition: unpowered rail vehicle for passengers or goods.
notes: Tatravagonka tank wagon page; Greenbrier Europe catalogue of tank, hopper, flat, covered, intermodal wagons; Viaggio Comfort coach.

name: Handcar (draisine, railbike)
definition: small rail vehicle moved by its riders' muscle (pumped or pedalled).
notes: Fleet of pedal electric-assist railbikes offered for sale; sold as railbike.

name: Railcar (multiple unit)
definition: self-propelled rail vehicle carrying passengers.
notes: Stadler FLIRT train page (title only); Coradia family of EMU and DMU.

name: Tram
definition: rail vehicle running on street track to carry passengers.
notes: Alstom Citadis light rail vehicles (trams); Stadler TRAMLINK tram.

name: Motor trolley
definition: small motorised rail vehicle for track inspection or maintenance crews.
notes: Geismar self-propelled diesel rail inspection trolley; Fairmont inspection trolley caption.

name: Kayak
definition: narrow paddle craft driven by a double-bladed paddle, rigid or inflatable (`construction`, G-8).
notes: Sit-inside and sit-on-top kayaks sold; rigid or inflatable not shown.

name: Canoe
definition: open paddle craft driven by a single-bladed paddle.
notes: Canoe category with Canoe Type lakewater and touring, single-bladed paddle propulsion listed.

name: Rowing boat
definition: small boat driven by oars.
notes: Whitehall rowboat with oars and sliding seat in a classifieds listing.

name: Rowing shell
definition: long narrow racing boat rowed with oars on sliding seats.
notes: Single scull racing shell listed on a trade catalogue.

name: Pedal boat
definition: small boat driven by pedals turning a paddle wheel or propeller.
notes: Pedal boats with slide sold to rental companies; swan and other animal shapes.

name: Sailing dinghy
definition: small open sailing monohull with a centreboard.
notes: Dinghy (Sail) is a listing type; guide names training, single- and double-handed dinghies.

name: Open keelboat (daysailer)
definition: sailing monohull with a ballast keel and no or minimal cabin.
notes: Only the marketplace type menu shows Daysailer; no daysailer listing page was fetched.

name: Cruising monohull
definition: sailing monohull with accommodation for living aboard.
notes: Beneteau Oceanis cruising models; marketplace type menu has Cruiser (Sail).

name: Beach catamaran
definition: open sailing multihull launched from a beach.
notes: Hobie Getaway described as double-handed sport/beach catamaran.

name: Cruising multihull
definition: sailing catamaran or trimaran with accommodation (`hull_count`).
notes: Builder guide lists Lagoon, Leopard, Fountaine Pajot and other cruising catamarans.

name: Motorsailer
definition: sailing craft with an engine strong enough to cruise under power (`propulsion` = wind + combustion engine, primary flag, G-2).
notes: Gulet described as a motor sailer; marketplace menu has Motorsailer (Sail).

name: Racer-cruiser
definition: sailing yacht with accommodation, made to both race and cruise.
notes: Only the marketplace type menu shows Cruiser/Racer; no listing page fetched.

name: Gulet
definition: traditional wooden two- or three-masted motor-sailing yacht for charter cruising.
notes: Rightboat gulet category: traditional Turkish wooden motor sailing vessel.

name: Bowrider (runabout)
definition: open powerboat with seating in the bow ahead of the helm.
notes: Bowrider is a YachtWay subtype and an Aceboater boat type.

name: Centre console boat
definition: open powerboat with the helm on a console in the middle of the deck.
notes: Center Console is a YachtWay subtype and an Aceboater boat type.

name: Cabin cruiser
definition: powerboat with an enclosed cabin for overnight use.
notes: Rightboat Cabin Cruiser category with Sea Ray Sundancer and similar.

name: Rigid inflatable boat (RIB)
definition: powerboat with a rigid hull and inflatable tubes.
notes: Defender sells rigid inflatable boats by Zodiac, Highfield, AB, Achilles.

name: Personal watercraft (PWC)
definition: small sit-on or stand-up jet-driven craft ridden like a motorcycle.
notes: Sea-Doo sells personal watercraft in segment series.

name: Cruising houseboat (navigating house barge)
definition: hull with its own propulsion and steering, made to be lived aboard and navigated (K-60).
notes: Page sells narrowboats; houseboat wording not on the page; narrowboat treated as named form.

name: Trawler
definition: displacement motor yacht with a trawler-style hull made for economical long-range cruising.
notes: Aceboater trawler boats: displacement hull, low horsepower; marketplace menu has Trawler.

name: Motor yacht
definition: large powerboat with accommodation for cruising.
notes: Aceboater motor yacht boats 12 m and longer; marketplace menu has Motor Yacht.

name: Sport-fishing boat
definition: powerboat made for offshore fishing.
notes: YachtWay Sport Fishing subtype with 388 listings.

name: Pontoon boat
definition: flat-decked powerboat on two or more pontoons.
notes: Aceboater pontoon boats 15-30 ft on aluminum tubes.

name: Jon boat
definition: flat-bottomed small powerboat for shallow water.
notes: Aceboater jon boats for shallow water.

name: Jet boat
definition: powerboat driven by a water jet.
notes: Aceboater jet boats with enclosed jet propulsion.

name: Tender
definition: small boat made to carry people and goods between a larger vessel and the shore.
notes: Marketplace type menu shows Tender (Power); no tender listing page fetched.

name: eFoil
definition: electric powered hydrofoil board ridden standing (K-90).
notes: E-SURFER retail page for Lift Foils electric hydrofoil boards.

name: Single-engine piston airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane with one piston engine.
notes: Controller category Piston Single Aircraft.

name: Turboprop airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane driven by one or more turboprop engines.
notes: Controller category Turboprop Aircraft.

name: Multi-engine piston airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane with two or more piston engines.
notes: Controller category Piston Twin Aircraft.

name: Jet
definition: fixed-wing airplane driven by jet engines, from light and business jets to airliners.
notes: Controller category Jet Aircraft: business jets.

name: Amphibian or floatplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane made to take off from and land on water.
notes: Controller category Piston Amphibious/Floatplanes.

name: Sailplane (glider)
definition: unpowered fixed-wing aircraft that flies by soaring.
notes: Schempp-Hirth and Schleicher sailplane product pages.

name: Motor-glider
definition: glider with an engine for take-off or sustaining flight.
notes: Pipistrel Taurus listed as motorized glider; Stemme S12 as touring motor glider.

name: Helicopter
definition: rotorcraft lifted and driven by powered rotors.
notes: Controller category Piston Helicopters; turbine category also exists.

name: Gyroplane
definition: rotorcraft with an unpowered rotor and a separate propeller.
notes: Magni M16C advertised as 2-seat tandem gyroplane.

name: Hot-air balloon
definition: lighter-than-air aircraft lifted by heated air in an envelope.
notes: Ultramagic Z series hot-air envelope; Cameron A-425 balloon envelope.

name: Gas balloon
definition: lighter-than-air aircraft lifted by a light gas, without propulsion.
notes: Cameron GB1000 hydrogen gas balloon page.

name: Airship
definition: powered, steerable lighter-than-air aircraft.
notes: Zeppelin NT described as airship type with N07-100 and N07-101 variants.

name: Powered parachute
definition: aircraft with a parachute wing and a motorised cart below it.
notes: Six Chuter Legend powered parachute certified as SLSA.

name: Weight-shift trike
definition: powered hang-glider-type wing over a trike, steered by shifting weight.
notes: Page is a weightshift microlight advert (P&M GT450, Quik wing); the word trike is not on the page.
